thesis: Wingstop Inc. memiliki fundamental lemah (skor 47/100) dengan keunggulan utama di kualitas bisnis (70) dan pertumbuhan (50). Titik lemahnya ada di valuasi (26). Gabungan model DCF, multiple sektor, dan target analis menghasilkan nilai wajar $113.44 — potensi turun 28.5% dalam ~12 bulan (keyakinan rendah). Kondisi teknikal lemah (50/100). Risiko geopolitik rendah.

cons.text: Harga sudah 28% di atas estimasi nilai wajar ($113.44).
Valuasi premium: P/E forward 31x vs median sektor 15x — ekspektasi pasar sudah tinggi.
Simulasi: 49% kemungkinan harga turun >20% dalam 12 bulan (volatilitas 66%/thn).
Volatilitas tinggi (beta 1.76) — pergerakan harga bisa tajam ke dua arah.

pros.text: 26 analis Wall Street, konsensus Strong Buy dengan target rata-rata $185.50 (+17%).
Margin operasi 28% — tanda pricing power dan keunggulan kompetitif (moat).
Laba per saham (EPS) diproyeksikan naik 18% — dari $4.27 ke $5.03.
Relative strength kuat: mengungguli S&P 500 sebesar 21% dalam 6 bulan.
RSI 61 — momentum sehat, belum jenuh beli.

summary: Wingstop Inc., together with its subsidiaries, franchises and operates restaurants under the Wingstop brand in United States, Australia, Bahrain, Kuwait, Puerto Rico, Saudi Arabia, and The Netherlands. Its restaurants provides classic wings, boneless wings, tenders, and hand-sauced-and-tossed in various flavors, as well as chicken sandwiches, fries, and hand-cut carrots and celery that are cooked-to-order. The company was founded in 1994 and is headquartered in Dallas, Texas.
